authority.rule: No secondary roadmap, blueprint, task queue, or agent plan may override the canonical blueprint.

agent_responsibilities.architecture: Keep implementation aligned with AI_BLUEPRINT.md and consolidate duplicate systems.
agent_responsibilities.backend: Implement and integrate production backend capabilities.
agent_responsibilities.frontend: Implement and integrate the Windows user experience.
agent_responsibilities.agents: Implement orchestration, agent lifecycle, memory, and tool use.
agent_responsibilities.tools: Implement the unified Tool/Action architecture, built-ins, plugins, and MCP integration.
agent_responsibilities.platform: Implement Windows-native capabilities, automation, packaging, and system integration.
agent_responsibilities.documentation: Keep documentation accurate and subordinate to the canonical blueprint.

testing_policy.note: Existing tests may remain for later validation, but testing is not an active development workstream.

historical_information.rule: Historical sessions, token counts, old task queues, and previous completion estimates are not current project state and must not drive development.

completion_rule.definition: The repository is complete only when the implementation described by AI_BLUEPRINT.md is implemented, integrated, organized, and ready for the final validation phase.
completion_rule.workflow: Inspect -> decide keep/fix/move/replace/remove -> implement -> integrate -> continue to next repository item.
